Ex-bureaucrats urge civil servants to uphold Constitution

Ninety-eight former civil servants have urged serving officers to uphold the values of the Constitution and resist unlawful orders, stating that dissent is increasingly being termed anti-national. The appeal emphasizes the importance of constitutional principles in governance.
